_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Oyikyerɛ {player_id} wɔ LinesOfAction agorɔ mu.
Wo pieces no yɛ '{side}', oponnyi pieces no yɛ '{other}'.
Move format: `[b1b3]` (firi-coord to-coord). Move a ɛfata no fa kwan horizontal, vertical, anaa diagonal a ɛyɛ squares dodoɔ a ɛyɛ pieces (kɔkɔɔ biara) wɔ saa line no mu. Wobɛtumi akɔtene wo pieces wɔn ho, nanso wuntumi ankɔtene oponnyi pieces; wokɔ a woduru oponnyi no, wobɛfa no.  Wo a wodi agorɔ no bere a wo pieces nyinaa yɛ 8-neighbour connected.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔfa saa kwan yi so: e2e4 (from,to coordinates).
invalid_move.identical: Ɛfiase ne baabi a wɔrekɔ yɛ pɛ.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Ɛsɛ sɛ akwantu no yɛ tee anaa diagonal.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwe wɔn ho fi akyiri a ɛne nnua no di nsɛ.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Ɔtamfo bi a ɔde ne nsa asi kwan no so.
invalid_move.destination_own: Ɔdan a wɔn ankasa hyɛ mu.

outcome.draw_repetition: Wɔsan yɛɛ tebea no ho adwuma mprɛnsa.
